description: Agate Black Metallic gives this 2020 Ford Escape SEL a polished look, and its low-profile two-row design makes it especially well suited to everyday Tampa Bay driving. With a turbocharged 1.5-liter EcoBoost engine, front-wheel drive, premium synthetic seating, and SEL-level convenience features, this Escape offers a useful blend of efficiency, comfort, and cargo flexibility without feeling oversized in traffic or parking lots.  The 1.5-liter EcoBoost three-cylinder is paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission. Turbocharging gives the Escape responsive low- and mid-range power for pulling away from lights or merging onto Interstate 75, while front-wheel drive keeps the layout light and efficient for a driver whose use is primarily on pavement. The suspension is tuned for everyday comfort and the Escapes compact exterior dimensions make it easy to maneuver around Wesley Chapel, New Tampa, and downtown Tampa.  SEL trim adds meaningful comfort features to the cabin. Premium synthetic seating surfaces, heated front seats, a power-adjustable drivers seat, dual-zone automatic climate control, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, push-button start, and remote start capability create a more upscale environment than an entry-level compact SUV. The cabin remains easy to use, with straightforward controls and good outward visibility for commuting, errands, and longer trips.  The rear seat provides flexible passenger and cargo space, and the sliding second-row design allows room to be balanced between rear-seat legroom and the cargo area. Fold the seats when larger items need to be carried and the Escape becomes useful for luggage, sports equipment, groceries, pet gear, or home-project supplies. A power liftgate adds convenience when loading with your hands full.  Fords SYNC 3 infotainment system supports Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth connectivity, audio functions, and voice control through a central touchscreen. Steering-wheel controls keep common functions close at hand, while multiple charging options help keep phones and other devices powered. A rearview camera and rear parking sensors help simplify backing and parking in tighter Tampa Bay spaces.  Ford Co-Pilot360 adds a useful group of driver-assistance technologies including Pre-Collision Assist with Automatic Emergency Braking, Blind Spot Information System with Cross-Traffic Alert, Lane-Keeping System, and automatic high-beam headlights. Stability control, traction control, antilock brakes, and a comprehensive airbag system add another layer of support when traffic or road conditions change unexpectedly.  This Escape is Ford Blue Certified, adding a 139-point inspection, a 90-day/4,000-mile Comprehensive Limited Warranty, 24/7 Roadside Assistance, and applicable FordPass Rewards Points. description: The2020 Porsche Panamera Sedan 4Drepresents a refined model year for the second-generation (G2) platform, serving as Porsche's entry-level, rear-wheel-drive flagship GT sports sedan. Built on a lightweight aluminum and high-strength steel unibody architecture with a low center of gravity, this four-door model combines pure sports-car handling precision with executive-class highway comfort, whisper-quiet cabin insulation, low maintenance downtime, and iconic Porsche flyline styling.Under the long front aluminum hood sits Porsche's3.0-liter Turbocharged DOHC 24-valve V6 engine, featuring a single twin-scroll turbocharger mounted in the engine's 'hot V.' This mechanical core delivers330 horsepowerat 5,400-6,400 RPM and331 lb-ft of torqueavailable across a broad rev band from 1,340 to 4,900 RPM. Power is managed by Porsche's rapid-shifting8-speed Porsche Doppelkupplung (PDK) dual-clutch automatic transmissionwith steering-wheel gearshift paddles. Drive torque is delivered strictly to the rear wheels via Rear-Wheel Drive (RWD). Supported by a 4-wheel aluminum double-wishbone front and multi-link rear suspension, steel springs with adaptive shock absorbers (PASM), and 6-piston aluminum monobloc front brake calipers clamping large ventilated rotors, the entry Panamera launches from0 to 60 MPH in 5.4 seconds(or 5.2 seconds with the optional Sport Chrono Package using Launch Control) on its way to a top track speed of164 MPH.On the exterior, the 2020 Panamera executes an athletic, low-slung visual statement defined by signature four-point LED headlights, dynamic daytime running lights, a continuous rear LED light strip spanning the tailgate, a deployed 2-way adaptive rear spoiler, and dual oval exhaust tailpipes. Standard exterior features include power-folding heated auto-dimming side mirrors, rain-sensing windshield wipers, a power panoramic sunroof, power liftback hatch, and an assertive stance rolling on19-inch 5-single-spoke alloy wheelswrapped in high-performance summer or all-season tires (with 20-inch and 21-inch wheels widely optioned).Inside, the driver-centric cockpit features a strict four-passenger luxury layout with two individual rear bucket seats separated by a full-length center console. The cabin is wrapped inpartial leather upholsterywith high-gloss black interior accents, 8-way power-adjustable heated front sport seats with driver memory,Dual-Zone Automatic Climate Control, proximity keyless entry with push-button start, auto-dimming rearview mirror, and a multi-function leather sport steering wheel. Digital connectivity centers around thePorsche Communication Management (PCM) system featuring a 12.3-inch high-resolution touchscreen display, accompanied by dual 7.0-inch driver instrument cluster displays on either side of the analog tachometer. System features include 3D Navigation with real-time traffic, Apple CarPlay compatibility, Bluetooth phone and audio streaming, SiriusXM satellite radio, dual USB charging ports, dynamic vehicle telemetry menus, and a standard 10-speaker 150-watt audio system (or available 14-speaker 710-wattBose Surround Sound Systemor 21-speaker 1,455-wattBurmester 3D High-End Surround Sound System).Practicality remains exceptionally high for a performance GT sedan thanks to its versatile rear liftback hatch design and long 116.1-inch wheelbase. Opening the power liftgate reveals17.6 cubic feet of flat cargo spacebehind the rear seats. Collapsing the 60/40 split-folding rear seatbacks completely flat unlocks an expansive total cargo volume of47.3 cubic feet, providing ample space to transport multi-person luggage sets, golf bags, camera equipment packages, or executive travel gear.Backed by a generous 23.7-gallon fuel tank to support long-distance GT travel, the 3.0L Turbo V6 RWD achieves an EPA-estimated19 MPG city and 27 MPG highway(22 MPG combined). Safety is world-class, utilizing an ultra-high-strength steel passenger safety cage structure. The vehicle comes factory-equipped with Porsche Stability Management (PSM), 4-wheel Anti-Lock Brakes (ABS), Lane Keep Assist with Traffic Sign Recognition, Front and Rear ParkAssist with Rearview Camera, Cruise Control, Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS), available Night Vision Assist, available Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC), and a comprehensive10-airbag protection canopy networkincluding dual front airbags, front and rear seat-mounted side airbags, driver/passenger knee airbags, and full-length side curtain airbagsto guarantee absolute driving confidence.[!@@Additional Info@@!]F&R Park Assist,Adaptive Cruise Control,Dual Power Seats,Power Liftgate Release,Backup Camera,Dual Air Bags,Daytime Running Lights,SiriusXM Satellite,Navigation System,AM/FM/HD Radio,Bluetooth Wireless,Tilt & Telescoping Wheel,Full Leather,Knee Air Bags,Alarm System,Power Door Locks,Alloy Wheels,LED Headlamps,V6 Turbo 3.0 Liter,Remote Engine Start,Stability Control,Power Steering,F&R Side Air Bags,Rear Spoiler,Keyless Entry,Heated Seats,F&R Head Curtain Air Bags,Air Conditioning,Automatic 8-Spd,Communication Management System,Power Windows,Traction Control,ABS (4-Wheel),CD/MP3 (Multi Disc),Panoramic Moon Roof,Cruise Control,RWD

Perforated leather seating surfaces in the front provide both comfort and durability, while heated and ventilated front seats ensure year-round comfort. The driver benefits from a power lumbar adjuster on both front seats, memory functions for individual driver preferences, and an available heated steering wheel for cold-weather convenience. Split-folding second-row bucket seats and a third-row split-bench configuration provide flexible seating for up to nine passengers.  Under the hood, the EcoTec3 6.2L V8 delivers substantial power paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel drive capability. This combination provides both the performance needed for towing and the fuel efficiency gains from modern transmission technology. The four-wheel independent suspension with Magnetic Ride Control automatically adjusts damping to road conditions, while auto-leveling capability maintains consistent ride height regardless of load.  Inside the cabin, the 16.8" Premium GMC Infotainment System serves as your command center, featuring integrated Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity for seamless smartphone integration. Navigation via GMC Connected Navigation, SiriusXM with 360L, and the Bose 10-speaker system create an entertainment environment that rivals premium audio installations. A 15" head-up display projects critical driving information directly into your line of sight, reducing the need to look away from the road.  Safety and convenience features underscore the Denali's commitment to modern vehicle ownership. The AutoSense hands-free power liftgate opens automatically when it detects the key fob, while the power-retractable assist steps lower automatically when you approach the vehicle. OnStar services provide emergency communication and vehicle diagnostics, giving you peace of mind whether parked at home or on the road.  The exterior combines function with striking presence. The power sunroof with perimeter lighting adds an open-air feel to the cabin, while the dual exhaust system provides visual distinction. Twenty-inch polished aluminum wheels mount to the vehicle's substantial frame, and the galvano bodyside moldings resist corrosion while enhancing the vehicle's profile. description: You do not lift an F-450 dually to blend inand this one-owner 2021 Ford Super Duty Lariat was built to own the road. Its deep Agate Black exterior is set off by a chrome grille, chrome front and rear bumpers, roof-clearance lights and the unmistakable width of its dual rear wheels. This is a serious heavy-duty diesel with the stance, equipment and presence to stand apart from ordinary trucks.  A custom three-inch lift kit gives this Crew Cab 4x4 a taller, more aggressive profile. Fuel wheels and brand-new 37-inch Nitto Ridge Grappler all-terrain tires complete the setup, giving the truck the perfect combination of size and style. The wide dually rear end adds stability and makes this lifted F-450 look ready to handle the jobs that smaller trucks cannot.  Under the hood is Fords proven 6.7-liter Power Stroke turbocharged diesel V8, paired with the smooth 10-speed TorqShift automatic transmission. Its 14,000-pound GVWR package, 397-amp alternator, Snow Plow Prep Package, rapid supplemental heater and engine block heater give it the equipment needed for demanding work. The FX4 Off-Road Package adds skid plates for protection on rough jobsites and uneven terrain.  Towing features include an integrated trailer brake controller, trailer sway control and PowerScope heated, power-folding and telescoping tow mirrors. A rear center high-mounted camera, reverse sensing system and rearview camera help the driver monitor the truck and equipment behind it. Tow hooks, upfitter switches, BoxLink, pickup-box tie-downs and a power tailgate lock add even more useful capability.  The black leather interior delivers Lariat comfort without losing the practical feel of a work truck. It includes a 10-way power drivers seat, an eight-way power passenger seat, heated and ventilated front seats and driver memory. Dual-zone automatic climate control, a leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls, a power-sliding rear window with privacy tint and defrost, and a 60/40 folding rear bench with under-seat storage make long drives easier.  Technology includes SYNC 3 with an eight-inch touchscreen, SiriusXM, FordPass Connect with a 4G Wi-Fi hotspot and a premium 10-speaker B&O sound system. BLIS with Cross-Traffic Alert, Pre-Collision Assist with Automatic Emergency Braking and AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control add confidence on the road. Remote start, remote keyless entry, rain-sensing wipers, a universal garage-door opener and a 110-volt/400-watt outlet provide added convenience. We are a one-of-a-kind dealership where the price you see is the price you payeverything is included, with no additional markups. Come see this lifted Ford dually and take it for a test drive, or call us to make your best deal over the phone.
